mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.projectId AS CHAR) AS source_key,chosen.projectId AS project_id,p.projectType AS project_type, p.projectCode AS original_project_code,current_project.projectCode AS project_code,NULL AS fingerprint FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.typeKey=CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY) AND chosen.codeKey=CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY) JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=chosen.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.projectType='10' ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT #{limit}
